rows.grounds: locative/indeclinable compound indicating position above the previously mentioned region; internal sandhi tad + ūrdhve
compound describing a lotus with its opening directed upward

items.question: What upward-facing lotus is situated above that previously described region?
premises: The location is specified as above that previously mentioned region.
A lotus with its face turned upward is present there.
The statement is addressed to the supreme goddess.
items.inference: Therefore, above that region there is likewise an upward-facing lotus.
items.plain_english: Above that, O Supreme Goddess, there is likewise a lotus facing upward.
